_comment: Format: package → list of CVE entries. affected_below is exclusive upper bound (version < affected_below is vulnerable).

jinja2.description: Sandbox bypass via str.format_map — attacker can access arbitrary attributes
XSS via xmlattr filter — HTML attribute values not fully escaped

pillow.description: Uncontrolled resource consumption in ImageFont — crafted font can exhaust memory
Arbitrary code execution via crafted image with malicious ICC profile

requests.description: Credentials forwarded to third-party hosts on cross-scheme redirects (http → https)
Proxy-Authorization header leaked to destination on http→https redirect

pyyaml.description: Arbitrary code execution via yaml.load() with untrusted input — use yaml.safe_load()

cryptography.description: NULL pointer dereference in PKCS12 parsing — remote DoS via crafted certificate
NULL pointer dereference in PKCS#12 key parsing

werkzeug.description: Debugger PIN brute-forceable — remote code execution when debugger is enabled

urllib3.description: ReDoS via malformed URL in the authority component
Request body not stripped on cross-origin redirect — may expose sensitive POST data

paramiko.description: Race condition in private key file creation — attacker may read key before permissions are set

django.description: Bypass of file upload validation — unique_for_date constraint not enforced
ReDoS in django.utils.text.Truncator.words() with HTML input

setuptools.description: ReDoS via malicious HTML in package metadata during package_index operations

aiohttp.description: CRLF injection via HTTP method — attacker can inject arbitrary headers
Path traversal in static file serving via symlinks outside the root

sqlalchemy.description: SQL injection via column names in ORM queries when using user-supplied column identifiers

lodash.description: Prototype pollution via Object.assign — attacker can inject properties on Object.prototype
Command injection via _.template with user-controlled source — arbitrary code execution

axios.description: ReDoS via crafted HTTP header value in SSRF URL validation
CSRF — X-XSRF-TOKEN header leaked to third-party origins on redirect

jsonwebtoken.description: Remote code execution via crafted secretOrPublicKey in jwt.verify()
Validation bypass — tokens with 'none' algorithm accepted when algorithms list is misconfigured

moment.description: Path traversal in locale loading — attacker can load arbitrary files as locale data

semver.description: ReDoS via overly large version string supplied to semver parsing functions

xml2js.description: Prototype pollution via __proto__ key in parsed XML attributes

node-fetch.description: Authorization header leaked on cross-origin redirect

minimatch.description: ReDoS via crafted glob pattern — unbounded backtracking in braces expansion

tar.description: Arbitrary file write via path traversal — crafted tar archive can write outside extraction root

follow-redirects.description: Proxy-Authorization header retained on cross-origin redirect — credential exposure

tough-cookie.description: Prototype pollution via special cookie domain attributes

body-parser.description: ReDoS via deeply nested JSON object in request body

qs.description: Prototype pollution via crafted query string — allows overwriting Object.prototype properties

serialize-javascript.description: Cross-site scripting — regex and function literals not properly escaped during serialization

next.description: Cache poisoning via crafted request headers on cached static pages

nokogiri.description: Integer overflow in libxml2 — crafted XML document can cause heap corruption
